root.title: API Root
root.description: The API root resource links to all other resources available in the API. Calling the root directory also returns details about the Mailchimp user account.

chimp-chatter.title: Chimp Chatter Activity
chimp-chatter.description: Get the latest Chimp Chatter activity from your account.

audiences.title: Audiences (BETA)
audiences.description: Your Mailchimp audience is where you store and manage all of your omni-channel contacts. The Audiences Endpoints (BETA) is available for evaluation or testing purposes only, may contain bugs or errors, and may not be as reliable as other Mailchimp features. Intuit may modify or discontinue this feature at any time without notice. By accessing the endpoints you agree to the [Audiences Endpoints (BETA) Terms of Use](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/audiences-introduction). Consent must be accurately mapped to the supported marketing consent values. Unsupported values - including opt-outs - must be updated manually. See [Audiences Endpoints (BETA) Documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/audiences-introduction) for terms and additional details.

audiences-contacts.title: Contacts
audiences-contacts.description: Manage contacts within a Mailchimp audience. The Audiences Endpoints (BETA) is available for evaluation or testing purposes only, may contain bugs or errors, and may not be as reliable as other Mailchimp features. Intuit may modify or discontinue this feature at any time without notice. By accessing the endpoints you agree to the [Audiences Endpoints (BETA) Terms of Use](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/audiences-introduction). Consent must be accurately mapped to the supported marketing consent values. Unsupported values - including opt-outs - must be updated manually. See [Audiences Endpoints (BETA) Documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/audiences-introduction) for terms and additional details.

authorized-apps.title: Authorized Apps
authorized-apps.description: Manage registered, connected apps for your Mailchimp account with the Authorized Apps endpoints.

automation.title: Classic Automations
automation.description: Mailchimp's classic automations feature lets you build a series of emails that send to subscribers when triggered by a specific date, activity, or event. Use the API to manage workflows, emails, and queues for Classic Automations. Does not include Automation flows.

automation-email.title: Emails
automation-email.description: Manage individual emails in a classic automation workflow.

automation-email-queue.title: Queue
automation-email-queue.description: Manage list member queues for classic automation emails.

automation-removed-subscribers.title: Removed Subscribers
automation-removed-subscribers.description: Remove subscribers from a classic automation workflow.

batch-operations.title: Batch Operations
batch-operations.description: Use batch operations to complete multiple operations with a single call.

account-exports.title: Account Exports
account-exports.description: Generate a new account export or download a finished account export.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Campaigns are how you send emails to your Mailchimp list. Use the Campaigns API calls to manage campaigns in your Mailchimp account.

sms-campaigns.title: SMS Campaigns
sms-campaigns.description: SMS Campaigns allow you to send text message marketing campaigns to your Mailchimp audience.

sms-campaign-content.title: SMS Campaign Content
sms-campaign-content.description: Manage the content of an SMS campaign.

campaign-feedback.title: Feedback
campaign-feedback.description: Post comments, reply to team feedback, and send test emails while you're working together on a Mailchimp campaign.

campaign-checklist.title: Send Checklist
campaign-checklist.description: Review the send checklist for your campaign, and resolve any issues before sending.

campaign-content.title: Content
campaign-content.description: Manage the HTML, plain-text, and template content for your Mailchimp campaigns.

connected-sites.title: Connected Sites
connected-sites.description: Manage sites you've connected to your Mailchimp account.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: Conversation tracking lets you view subscribers' replies to your campaigns in your Mailchimp account.

conversation-messages.title: Messages
conversation-messages.description: Manage messages in a specific campaign conversation.

file-manager.title: File Manager
file-manager.description: Manage files for your Mailchimp account. The File Manager is a place to store images, documents, and other files you include or link to in your campaigns, templates, or signup forms.

file-manager-folders.title: File Manager Folders
file-manager-folders.description: Manage specific folders in the File Manager for your Mailchimp account.

file-manager-files.title: File Manager Files
file-manager-files.description: Manage specific files in the File Manager for your Mailchimp account.

file-manager-folders-files.title: Files in Folder
file-manager-folders-files.description: Manage specific files in a folder.

landing-pages.title: Landing Pages
landing-pages.description: Manage your Landing Pages, including publishing and unpublishing.

landing-pages-content.title: Content
landing-pages-content.description: The HTML content for your Mailchimp landing pages.

lists.title: Lists/Audiences
lists.description: Your Mailchimp list, also known as your audience, is where you store and manage all of your contacts.

list-members.title: Members
list-members.description: Manage members of a specific Mailchimp list, including currently subscribed, unsubscribed, and bounced members.

list-merges.title: Merge Fields
list-merges.description: Manage merge fields for an audience. See [Merge Field documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/merge-fields/) for more.

abuse-reports.title: Abuse Reports
abuse-reports.description: Manage abuse complaints for a specific list. An abuse complaint occurs when your recipient reports an email as spam in their mail program.

list-activity.title: Activity
list-activity.description: Get recent daily, aggregated activity stats for your list. For example, view unsubscribes, signups, total emails sent, opens, clicks, and more, for up to 180 days.

list-clients.title: Clients
list-clients.description: Get information about the most popular email clients for subscribers in a specific Mailchimp list.

list-growth-history.title: Growth History
list-growth-history.description: View a summary of the month-by-month growth activity for a specific list.

list-webhooks.title: Webhooks
list-webhooks.description: Manage webhooks for a specific Mailchimp list.

list-surveys.title: Surveys
list-surveys.description: Get survey data for this audience.

interest-categories.title: Interest Categories
interest-categories.description: Manage interest categories for a specific list. Interest categories organize interests, which are used to group subscribers based on their preferences. These correspond to 'group titles' in the Mailchimp application.

interests.title: Interests
interests.description: Manage interests for a specific Mailchimp list. Assign subscribers to interests to group them together. Interests are referred to as 'group names' in the Mailchimp application.

lists-tags-search.title: Tag Search
lists-tags-search.description: Search for tags on a list by name.

list-segments.title: Segments
list-segments.description: Manage segments and tags for a specific Mailchimp list. A segment is a section of your list that includes only those subscribers who share specific common field information. Tags are labels you create to help organize your contacts.

list-segment-members.title: Segment Members
list-segment-members.description: Manage list members in a saved segment.

list-member-activity.title: Member Activity
list-member-activity.description: Get details about a subscriber's recent activity. Use the new activity-feed endpoint to access more events for a given contact.

list-member-activity-feed.title: Member Activity Feed
list-member-activity-feed.description: Get details about a subscriber's recent activity.

list-member-goal.title: Member Goals
list-member-goal.description: Get information about recent goal events for a specific list member.

list-member-notes.title: Member Notes
list-member-notes.description: Retrieve recent notes for a specific list member.

list-member-tags.title: Member Tags
list-member-tags.description: Manage all the tags that have been assigned to a contact.

list-member-events.title: Events
list-member-events.description: Use the Events endpoint to collect website or in-app actions and trigger targeted automations.

list-locations.title: Locations
list-locations.description: Get the locations (countries) that the list's subscribers have been tagged to based on geocoding their IP address.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Manage campaign reports for your Mailchimp account. All Reports endpoints are read-only. Mailchimp's campaign and automation reports analyze clicks, opens, subscribers' social activity, e-commerce data, and more. Note: Campaign IDs for A/B Testing Campaigns are available through the Campaign API Endpoint's Read method.

campaign-abuse.title: Campaign Abuse
campaign-abuse.description: Get information about campaign abuse complaints.

campaign-advice.title: Campaign Advice
campaign-advice.description: Get recent feedback based on a campaign's statistics.

open-reports.title: Campaign Open Reports
open-reports.description: Get a detailed report about any emails in a specific campaign that were opened by the recipient.

click-reports.title: Click Reports
click-reports.description: Get detailed information about links clicked in campaigns.

campaign-ecommerce-product-activity.title: Ecommerce Product Activity
campaign-ecommerce-product-activity.description: Ecommerce product activity report for a campaign.

link-clickers.title: Click Reports Members
link-clickers.description: Get information about specific subscribers who clicked on links in a campaign.

domain-performance-reports.title: Domain Performance
domain-performance-reports.description: Get statistics for the top-performing domains from a campaign.

eepurl-reports.title: EepURL Reports
eepurl-reports.description: Get a summary of social activity for the campaign, tracked by EepURL.

email-activity-reports.title: Email Activity
email-activity-reports.description: Get list member activity for a specific campaign.

location-reports.title: Location
location-reports.description: Get top open locations for a specific campaign.

sub-reports.title: Sub-Reports
sub-reports.description: A list of reports for child campaigns of a specific parent campaign. For example, use this endpoint to view Multivariate, RSS, and A/B Testing Campaign reports.

unsub-reports.title: Unsubscribes
unsub-reports.description: Get information about list members who unsubscribed from a specific campaign.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Manage your Mailchimp templates. A template is an HTML file used to create the layout and basic design for a campaign.

template-default-content.title: Default Content
template-default-content.description: Manage the default content for a Mailchimp template.

ecommerce-stores.title: E-commerce Stores
ecommerce-stores.description: Connect your E-commerce Store to Mailchimp to take advantage of powerful reporting and personalization features and to learn more about your customers.

ecommerce-customers.title: Customers
ecommerce-customers.description: Add Customers to your Store to track their orders and to view E-Commerce Data for your Mailchimp lists and campaigns. Each Customer is connected to a Mailchimp list member, so adding a Customer can also add or update a list member.

ecommerce-promo-rules.title: Promo Rules
ecommerce-promo-rules.description: Promo Rules help you create promo codes for your campaigns. Promo Rules define generic information about promo codes like expiration time, start time, amount of discount being offered etc. For a given promo rule you can define if it's a percentage discount or a fixed amount and if it applies for the order as a whole or if it's per item or free shipping. You can then create promo codes for this price rule. Promo codes contain the actual code that is applied at checkout along with some other information. Price Rules have one to many relationship with promo codes.

ecommerce-promo-codes.title: Promo Codes
ecommerce-promo-codes.description: Promo codes can be created for a given price rule. All the promo codes under a price rule share the generic information defined for that rule like the amount, type, expiration date etc. Promo code defines the more specific information about a promo code like the actual code, redemption_url, usage_count, etc that's unique to a code. Promo Code must be defined under a promo rule.

ecommerce-orders.title: Orders
ecommerce-orders.description: Orders represent successful e-commerce transactions, and this data can be used to provide more detailed campaign reports, track sales, and personalize emails to your targeted consumers, and view other e-commerce data in your Mailchimp account.

ecommerce-order-lines.title: Order Lines
ecommerce-order-lines.description: Each Order contains one or more Order Lines, which represent a specific Product Variant that a Customer purchases.

ecommerce-products.title: Products
ecommerce-products.description: E-commerce items for sale in your store need to be created as Products so you can add the items to a Cart or an Order. Each Product requires at least one Product Variant.

ecommerce-product-variants.title: Product Variants
ecommerce-product-variants.description: A Product Variant represents a specific item for purchase, and is contained within a parent Product. At least one Product Variant is required for each Product.

ecommerce-product-images.title: Product Images
ecommerce-product-images.description: A Product Image represents a specific product image.

ecommerce-carts.title: Carts
ecommerce-carts.description: Use Carts to represent unfinished e-commerce transactions. This can be used to create an Abandoned Cart workflow, or to save a consumer’s shopping cart pending a successful Order.

ecommerce-cart-lines.title: Cart Lines
ecommerce-cart-lines.description: Each Cart contains one or more Cart Lines, which represent a specific Product Variant that a Customer has added to their shopping cart.

ping.title: Ping
ping.description: A health check endpoint for Mailchimp API 3.0.

reporting-facebook-ads.title: Facebook Ads
reporting-facebook-ads.description: Get information about Facebook Ad reports.

reporting-landing-pages.title: Landing Pages
reporting-landing-pages.description: Get information about Landing Page reports.

reporting-surveys.title: Surveys
reporting-surveys.description: Get an overall report for a [hosted survey](https://mailchimp.com/help/create-a-survey/).

reporting-surveys-questions.title: Survey Questions
reporting-surveys-questions.description: Get reports by question on a [hosted survey](https://mailchimp.com/help/create-a-survey/).

reporting-surveys-questions-answers.title: Survey Question Answers
reporting-surveys-questions-answers.description: Answers to specific questions on a [hosted survey](https://mailchimp.com/help/create-a-survey/).

reporting-surveys-responses.title: Survey Responses
reporting-surveys-responses.description: Get survey response reports for a [hosted survey](https://mailchimp.com/help/create-a-survey/).

search-campaigns.title: Search Campaigns
search-campaigns.description: Search all of an account's campaigns for the specified query terms.

search-members.title: Search Members
search-members.description: Search the account or a specific list for members that match the specified query terms.

verified-domains.title: Verified Domains
verified-domains.description: Manage the domains on your account that can be used for sending email campaigns.

info.title: Mailchimp Marketing API
info.x-auth-instructions: Get an API key at https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/ and set MAILCHIMP_API_KEY. The key has format `key-dc` (e.g., abc...-us6); the suffix is your datacenter. The CLI parses the suffix to route requests.
info.x-cli-description: Drive Mailchimp from the terminal: every audience, campaign, automation, and e-commerce endpoint, plus eight workflow commands that compose what the API forces you to assemble yourself.

industry_stats.description: The [average campaign statistics](https://mailchimp.com/resources/research/email-marketing-benchmarks/?utm_source=mc-api&utm_medium=docs&utm_campaign=apidocs) for all campaigns in the account's specified industry.

parameters.name: fields

parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paginate through a collection of records by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request. Default value fetches the first "page" of results.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Restricts the response to contacts created at or before the specified time (inclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: created_since
parameters.description: Restricts the response to contacts created after the specified time (exclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: updated_before
parameters.description: Restricts the response to contacts updated at or before the specified time (inclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Restricts the response to contacts updated after the specified time (exclusive). Uses ISO 8601 format: 2025-04-23T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: audience_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the audience.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: Specifies the field to sort the returned contacts by.

parameters.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

effective_subscription_status.description: A computation performed by the Mailchimp platform, triggered whenever any of its inputs change. Some inputs are controlled by API users, while others are tracked internally by the platform. Computation is based on: audience opt-in configuration (single vs. double opt-in), marketing consent status, and deliverability status (an internal state for a contact, maintained by Mailchimp for a specific marketing channel instance). This new API field is distinct from how contacts are displayed in the UI. See the [Audiences (BETA) documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/audiences-introduction) to learn about supported values.

parameters.name: exclude_fields

parameters.description: Restrict the response to automations created before this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: since_create_time
parameters.description: Restrict the response to automations created after this time. Uses the ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_start_time

get.description: Get all campaigns in an account.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: exclude_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The campaign type.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The status of the campaign.

parameters.name: before_send_time
parameters.description: Restrict the response to campaigns sent before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: since_send_time
parameters.description: Restrict the response to campaigns sent after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_create_time
parameters.description: Restrict the response to campaigns created before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: since_create_time
parameters.description: Restrict the response to campaigns created after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique id for the list.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: The unique folder id.

parameters.name: member_id
parameters.description: Retrieve campaigns sent to a particular list member. Member ID is The MD5 hash of the lowercase version of the list member’s email address.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

parameters.name: include_resend_shortcut_eligibility
parameters.description: Return the `resend_shortcut_eligibility` field in the response, which tells you if the campaign is eligible for the various Campaign Resend Shortcuts offered.

parameters.name: include_resend_shortcut_usage
parameters.description: Return the `resend_shortcut_usage` field in the response.  This includes information about campaigns related by a shortcut.

schema.description: An array of campaigns.

items.title: Campaign
items.description: A summary of an individual campaign's settings and content.

id.title: Campaign ID
id.description: A string that uniquely identifies this campaign.

web_id.title: Campaign Web ID
web_id.description: The ID used in the Mailchimp web application. View this campaign in your Mailchimp account at `https://{dc}.admin.mailchimp.com/campaigns/show/?id={web_id}`.

parent_campaign_id.title: Parent Campaign ID
parent_campaign_id.description: If this campaign is the child of another campaign, this identifies the parent campaign. For Example, for RSS or Automation children.

type.title: Campaign Type
type.description: There are four types of [campaigns](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-campaigns/) you can create in Mailchimp. A/B Split campaigns have been deprecated and variate campaigns should be used instead.

create_time.title: Create Time
create_time.description: The date and time the campaign was created in ISO 8601 format.

archive_url.title: Archive URL
archive_url.description: The link to the campaign's archive version in ISO 8601 format.

long_archive_url.title: Long Archive URL
long_archive_url.description: The original link to the campaign's archive version.

status.title: Campaign Status
status.description: The current status of the campaign.

emails_sent.title: Emails Sent
emails_sent.description: The total number of emails sent for this campaign.

send_time.title: Send Time
send_time.description: The date and time a campaign was sent.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: How the campaign's content is put together.

needs_block_refresh.title: Needs Block Refresh
needs_block_refresh.description: Determines if the campaign needs its blocks refreshed by opening the web-based campaign editor. Deprecated and will always return false.

resendable.title: Resendable
resendable.description: Determines if the campaign qualifies to be resent to non-openers.

list_id.title: List ID
list_id.description: The unique list id.

list_is_active.title: List Status
list_is_active.description: The status of the list used, namely if it's deleted or disabled.

segment_text.title: Segment Text
segment_text.description: A description of the [segment](https://mailchimp.com/help/create-and-send-to-a-segment/) used for the campaign. Formatted as a string marked up with HTML.

recipient_count.title: Recipient Count
recipient_count.description: Count of the recipients on the associated list. Formatted as an integer.

segment_opts.title: Segment Options
segment_opts.description: An object representing all segmentation options. This object should contain a `saved_segment_id` to use an existing segment, or you can create a new segment by including both `match` and `conditions` options.

saved_segment_id.title: Saved Segment ID
saved_segment_id.description: The id for an existing saved segment.

prebuilt_segment_id.title: Prebuilt Segment Id
prebuilt_segment_id.description: The prebuilt segment id, if a prebuilt segment has been designated for this campaign.

conditions.title: Segment Type
conditions.description: Segment match conditions. There are multiple possible types, see the [condition types documentation](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/alternative-schemas/#segment-condition-schemas).

oneOf.title: Aim Segment
oneOf.description: Segment by interaction with a specific campaign.

field.title: Segment Field
field.description: Segment by interaction with a specific campaign.

op.title: Segment Operator
op.description: The status of the member with regard to their campaign interaction. One of the following: opened, clicked, was sent, didn't open, didn't click, or was not sent.

value.title: Segment Data
value.description: Either the web id value for a specific campaign or 'any' to account for subscribers who have/have not interacted with any campaigns.

oneOf.title: Automation Segment
oneOf.description: Segment by interaction with an Automation workflow.

field.title: Segment Field
field.description: Segment by interaction with an Automation workflow.

op.title: Segment Operator
op.description: The status of the member with regard to the automation workflow. One of the following: has started the workflow, has completed the workflow, has not started the workflow, or has not completed the workflow.

value.title: Segment Data
value.description: The web id for the automation workflow to segment against.

oneOf.title: Poll Activity Segment
oneOf.description: Segment by poll activity.

field.title: Segment Field
field.description: Segment by poll activity.

op.title: Segment Operator
op.description: Members have/have not interacted with a specific poll in a Mailchimp email.

value.title: Segment Operator
value.description: The id for the poll.

oneOf.title: Conversation Segment
oneOf.description: Segment by interaction with a campaign via Conversations.

field.title: Segment Field
field.description: Segment by interaction with a campaign via Conversations.

op.title: Segment Operator

settings.title: Campaign Settings
settings.description: The settings for your campaign, including subject, from name, reply-to address, and more.

subject_line.title: Campaign Subject Line
subject_line.description: The subject line for the campaign.

preview_text.title: Campaign Preview Text
preview_text.description: The preview text for the campaign.

title.title: Campaign Title
title.description: The title of the campaign.

from_name.title: From Name
from_name.description: The 'from' name on the campaign (not an email address).

reply_to.title: Reply To Address
reply_to.description: The reply-to email address for the campaign.

use_conversation.title: Conversation
use_conversation.description: Use Mailchimp Conversation feature to manage replies.

to_name.title: To Name
to_name.description: The campaign's custom 'To' name. Typically the first name [audience field](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-merge-tags/).

folder_id.title: Folder ID
folder_id.description: If the campaign is listed in a folder, the id for that folder.

authenticate.title: Authentication
authenticate.description: Whether Mailchimp [authenticated](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-email-authentication/) the campaign. Defaults to `true`.

auto_footer.title: Auto-Footer
auto_footer.description: Automatically append Mailchimp's [default footer](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-campaign-footers/) to the campaign.

inline_css.title: Inline CSS
inline_css.description: Automatically inline the CSS included with the campaign content.

auto_tweet.title: Auto-Tweet
auto_tweet.description: Automatically tweet a link to the [campaign archive](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-email-campaign-archives-and-pages/) page when the campaign is sent.

auto_fb_post.title: Auto Post to Facebook
auto_fb_post.description: An array of [Facebook](https://mailchimp.com/help/connect-or-disconnect-the-facebook-integration/) page ids to auto-post to.

fb_comments.title: Facebook Comments
fb_comments.description: Allows Facebook comments on the campaign (also force-enables the Campaign Archive toolbar). Defaults to `true`.

template_id.title: Template ID
template_id.description: The id for the template used in this campaign.

drag_and_drop.title: Drag And Drop Campaign
drag_and_drop.description: Whether the campaign uses the drag-and-drop editor.

variate_settings.title: A/B Test Options
variate_settings.description: The settings specific to A/B test campaigns.

winning_campaign_id.title: Winning Campaign ID
winning_campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that was sent to the remaining recipients based on the winning combination.

winner_criteria.title: Winning Criteria
winner_criteria.description: The combination that performs the best. This may be determined automatically by click rate, open rate, or total revenue -- or you may choose manually based on the reporting data you find the most valuable. For Multivariate Campaigns testing send_time, winner_criteria is ignored. For Multivariate Campaigns with 'manual' as the winner_criteria, the winner must be chosen in the Mailchimp web application.

wait_time.title: Wait Time
wait_time.description: The number of minutes to wait before choosing the winning campaign. The value of wait_time must be greater than 0 and in whole hours, specified in minutes.

test_size.title: Test Size
test_size.description: The percentage of recipients to send the test combinations to, must be a value between 10 and 100.

subject_lines.title: Subject Lines
subject_lines.description: The possible subject lines to test. If no subject lines are provided, settings.subject_line will be used.

send_times.title: Send Times
send_times.description: The possible send times to test. The times provided should be in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. If send_times are provided to test, the test_size will be set to 100% and winner_criteria will be ignored.

from_names.title: From Names
from_names.description: The possible from names. The number of from_names provided must match the number of reply_to_addresses. If no from_names are provided, settings.from_name will be used.

reply_to_addresses.title: Reply To Addresses
reply_to_addresses.description: The possible reply-to addresses. The number of reply_to_addresses provided must match the number of from_names. If no reply_to_addresses are provided, settings.reply_to will be used.

contents.title: Content Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of possible email contents. To set campaign contents, make a PUT request to /campaigns/{campaign_id}/content with the field 'variate_contents'.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.description: Combinations of possible variables used to build emails.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique ID for the combination.

subject_line.title: Subject Line
subject_line.description: The index of `variate_settings.subject_lines` used.

send_time.title: Send Time
send_time.description: The index of `variate_settings.send_times` used.

from_name.title: From Name
from_name.description: The index of `variate_settings.from_names` used.

reply_to.title: Reply To
reply_to.description: The index of `variate_settings.reply_to_addresses` used.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: The number of recipients for this combination.

tracking.title: Campaign Tracking Options
tracking.description: The tracking options for a campaign.

opens.title: Opens
opens.description: Whether to [track opens](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-open-tracking/). Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

html_clicks.title: HTML Click Tracking
html_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

text_clicks.title: Plain-Text Click Tracking
text_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

google_analytics.title: Google Analytics Tracking
google_analytics.description: The custom slug for [Google Analytics](https://mailchimp.com/help/integrate-google-analytics-with-mailchimp/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

clicktale.title: ClickTale Analytics Tracking
clicktale.description: The custom slug for [ClickTale](https://mailchimp.com/help/additional-tracking-options-for-campaigns/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

campaign.title: Salesforce Campaign
campaign.description: Create a campaign in a connected Salesforce account.

notes.title: Salesforce Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

notes.title: Capsule Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

feed_url.title: Feed URL
feed_url.description: The URL for the RSS feed.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: The frequency of the RSS Campaign.

schedule.title: Sending Schedule
schedule.description: The schedule for sending the RSS Campaign.

hour.title: Sending Hour
hour.description: The hour to send the campaign in local time. Acceptable hours are 0-23. For example, '4' would be 4am in [your account's default time zone](https://mailchimp.com/help/set-account-details/).

daily_send.title: Daily Sending Days
daily_send.description: The days of the week to send a daily RSS Campaign.

sunday.title: Sunday
sunday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Sundays.

monday.title: Monday
monday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Mondays.

tuesday.title: tuesday
tuesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Tuesdays.

wednesday.title: Monday
wednesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Wednesdays.

thursday.title: Thursday
thursday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Thursdays.

friday.title: Friday
friday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Fridays.

saturday.title: Saturday
saturday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Saturdays.

weekly_send_day.title: Weekly Sending Day
weekly_send_day.description: The day of the week to send a weekly RSS Campaign.

monthly_send_date.title: Monthly Sending Day
monthly_send_date.description: The day of the month to send a monthly RSS Campaign. Acceptable days are 0-31, where '0' is always the last day of a month. Months with fewer than the selected number of days will not have an RSS campaign sent out that day. For example, RSS Campaigns set to send on the 30th will not go out in February.

last_sent.title: Last Sent
last_sent.description: The date the campaign was last sent.

constrain_rss_img.title: Constrain RSS Images
constrain_rss_img.description: Whether to add CSS to images in the RSS feed to constrain their width in campaigns.

split_test.title: Split Test
split_test.description: The type of AB split to run.

pick_winner.title: Pick Winner
pick_winner.description: How we should evaluate a winner. Based on 'opens', 'clicks', or 'manual'.

wait_units.title: Wait Time
wait_units.description: How unit of time for measuring the winner ('hours' or 'days'). This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

wait_time.title: Wait Time
wait_time.description: The amount of time to wait before picking a winner. This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

split_size.title: Split Size
split_size.description: The size of the split groups. Campaigns split based on 'schedule' are forced to have a 50/50 split. Valid split integers are between 1-50.

from_name_a.title: From Name Group A
from_name_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group A.

from_name_b.title: From Name Group B
from_name_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group B.

reply_email_a.title: Reply Email Group A
reply_email_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group A.

reply_email_b.title: Reply Email Group B
reply_email_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group B.

subject_a.title: Subject Line Group A
subject_a.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group A.

subject_b.title: Subject Line Group B
subject_b.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group B.

send_time_a.title: Send Time Group A
send_time_a.description: The send time for Group A.

send_time_b.title: Send Time Group B
send_time_b.description: The send time for Group B.

send_time_winner.title: Send Time Winner
send_time_winner.description: The send time for the winning version.

social_card.title: Campaign Social Card
social_card.description: The preview for the campaign, rendered by social networks like Facebook and Twitter. [Learn more](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-customize-social-cards/).

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: The url for the header image for the card.

description.title: Campaign Description
description.description: A short summary of the campaign to display.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the card. Typically the subject line of the campaign.

report_summary.title: Campaign Report Summary
report_summary.description: For sent campaigns, a summary of opens and clicks.

opens.title: Automation Opens
opens.description: The total number of opens for a campaign.

open_rate.title: Open Rate
open_rate.description: The number of unique opens divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

clicks.title: Total Clicks
clicks.description: The total number of clicks for an campaign.

click_rate.title: Click Rate
click_rate.description: The number of unique clicks divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

total_orders.title: Total Orders
total_orders.description: The total orders for a campaign.

total_spent.title: Total Spent
total_spent.description: The total spent for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals with no deductions.

total_revenue.title: Total Revenue
total_revenue.description: The total revenue for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals minus shipping and tax totals.

delivery_status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
delivery_status.description: Updates on campaigns in the process of sending.

enabled.title: Delivery Status Enabled
enabled.description: Whether Campaign Delivery Status is enabled for this account and campaign.

can_cancel.title: Campaign Cancelable
can_cancel.description: Whether a campaign send can be canceled.

status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
status.description: The current state of a campaign delivery.

emails_sent.title: Emails Sent
emails_sent.description: The total number of emails confirmed sent for this campaign so far.

emails_canceled.title: Emails Canceled
emails_canceled.description: The total number of emails canceled for this campaign.

_links.description: A list of link types and descriptions for the API schema documents.

items.title: Resource Link
items.description: This object represents a link from the resource where it is found to another resource or action that may be performed.

rel.title: Rel
rel.description: As with an HTML 'rel' attribute, this describes the type of link.

href.title: Href
href.description: This property contains a fully-qualified URL that can be called to retrieve the linked resource or perform the linked action.

method.title: Method
method.description: The HTTP method that should be used when accessing the URL defined in 'href'.

targetSchema.title: Target Schema
targetSchema.description: For GETs, this is a URL representing the schema that the response should conform to.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: For HTTP methods that can receive bodies (POST and PUT), this is a URL representing the schema that the body should conform to.

parameters.description: The unique id for the campaign.

schedule_time.title: Schedule Time
schedule_time.description: The UTC date and time to schedule the campaign for delivery in ISO 8601 format. Campaigns may only be scheduled to send on the quarter-hour (:00, :15, :30, :45).

timewarp.title: Timewarp
timewarp.description: Choose whether the campaign should use [Timewarp](https://mailchimp.com/help/use-timewarp/) when sending. Campaigns scheduled with Timewarp are localized based on the recipients' time zones. For example, a Timewarp campaign with a `schedule_time` of 13:00 will be sent to each recipient at 1:00pm in their local time. Cannot be set to `true` for campaigns using [Batch Delivery](https://mailchimp.com/help/schedule-batch-delivery/).

batch_delivery.title: Batch Delivery
batch_delivery.description: Choose whether the campaign should use [Batch Delivery](https://mailchimp.com/help/schedule-batch-delivery/). Cannot be set to `true` for campaigns using [Timewarp](https://mailchimp.com/help/use-timewarp/).

batch_delay.title: Batch Delay
batch_delay.description: The delay, in minutes, between batches.

batch_count.title: Batch Count
batch_count.description: The number of batches for the campaign send.

auto_fb_post.description: An array of [Facebook](https://mailchimp.com/help/connect-or-disconnect-the-facebook-integration/) page ids to auto-post to.

fb_comments.title: Facebook Comments
fb_comments.description: Allows Facebook comments on the campaign (also force-enables the Campaign Archive toolbar). Defaults to `true`.

template_id.title: Template ID
template_id.description: The id for the template used in this campaign.

drag_and_drop.title: Drag And Drop Campaign
drag_and_drop.description: Whether the campaign uses the drag-and-drop editor.

variate_settings.title: A/B Test Options
variate_settings.description: The settings specific to A/B test campaigns.

winning_campaign_id.title: Winning Campaign ID
winning_campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign that was sent to the remaining recipients based on the winning combination.

winner_criteria.title: Winning Criteria
winner_criteria.description: The combination that performs the best. This may be determined automatically by click rate, open rate, or total revenue -- or you may choose manually based on the reporting data you find the most valuable. For Multivariate Campaigns testing send_time, winner_criteria is ignored. For Multivariate Campaigns with 'manual' as the winner_criteria, the winner must be chosen in the Mailchimp web application.

wait_time.title: Wait Time
wait_time.description: The number of minutes to wait before choosing the winning campaign. The value of wait_time must be greater than 0 and in whole hours, specified in minutes.

test_size.title: Test Size
test_size.description: The percentage of recipients to send the test combinations to, must be a value between 10 and 100.

subject_lines.title: Subject Lines
subject_lines.description: The possible subject lines to test. If no subject lines are provided, settings.subject_line will be used.

send_times.title: Send Times
send_times.description: The possible send times to test. The times provided should be in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. If send_times are provided to test, the test_size will be set to 100% and winner_criteria will be ignored.

from_names.title: From Names
from_names.description: The possible from names. The number of from_names provided must match the number of reply_to_addresses. If no from_names are provided, settings.from_name will be used.

reply_to_addresses.title: Reply To Addresses
reply_to_addresses.description: The possible reply-to addresses. The number of reply_to_addresses provided must match the number of from_names. If no reply_to_addresses are provided, settings.reply_to will be used.

contents.title: Content Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of possible email contents. To set campaign contents, make a PUT request to /campaigns/{campaign_id}/content with the field 'variate_contents'.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.description: Combinations of possible variables used to build emails.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique ID for the combination.

subject_line.title: Subject Line
subject_line.description: The index of `variate_settings.subject_lines` used.

send_time.title: Send Time
send_time.description: The index of `variate_settings.send_times` used.

from_name.title: From Name
from_name.description: The index of `variate_settings.from_names` used.

reply_to.title: Reply To
reply_to.description: The index of `variate_settings.reply_to_addresses` used.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: The number of recipients for this combination.

tracking.title: Campaign Tracking Options
tracking.description: The tracking options for a campaign.

opens.title: Opens
opens.description: Whether to [track opens](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-open-tracking/). Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

html_clicks.title: HTML Click Tracking
html_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

text_clicks.title: Plain-Text Click Tracking
text_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

google_analytics.title: Google Analytics Tracking
google_analytics.description: The custom slug for [Google Analytics](https://mailchimp.com/help/integrate-google-analytics-with-mailchimp/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

clicktale.title: ClickTale Analytics Tracking
clicktale.description: The custom slug for [ClickTale](https://mailchimp.com/help/additional-tracking-options-for-campaigns/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

campaign.title: Salesforce Campaign
campaign.description: Create a campaign in a connected Salesforce account.

notes.title: Salesforce Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

notes.title: Capsule Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

feed_url.title: Feed URL
feed_url.description: The URL for the RSS feed.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: The frequency of the RSS Campaign.

schedule.title: Sending Schedule
schedule.description: The schedule for sending the RSS Campaign.

hour.title: Sending Hour
hour.description: The hour to send the campaign in local time. Acceptable hours are 0-23. For example, '4' would be 4am in [your account's default time zone](https://mailchimp.com/help/set-account-details/).

daily_send.title: Daily Sending Days
daily_send.description: The days of the week to send a daily RSS Campaign.

sunday.title: Sunday
sunday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Sundays.

monday.title: Monday
monday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Mondays.

tuesday.title: tuesday
tuesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Tuesdays.

wednesday.title: Monday
wednesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Wednesdays.

thursday.title: Thursday
thursday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Thursdays.

friday.title: Friday
friday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Fridays.

saturday.title: Saturday
saturday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Saturdays.

weekly_send_day.title: Weekly Sending Day
weekly_send_day.description: The day of the week to send a weekly RSS Campaign.

monthly_send_date.title: Monthly Sending Day
monthly_send_date.description: The day of the month to send a monthly RSS Campaign. Acceptable days are 0-31, where '0' is always the last day of a month. Months with fewer than the selected number of days will not have an RSS campaign sent out that day. For example, RSS Campaigns set to send on the 30th will not go out in February.

last_sent.title: Last Sent
last_sent.description: The date the campaign was last sent.

constrain_rss_img.title: Constrain RSS Images
constrain_rss_img.description: Whether to add CSS to images in the RSS feed to constrain their width in campaigns.

split_test.title: Split Test
split_test.description: The type of AB split to run.

pick_winner.title: Pick Winner
pick_winner.description: How we should evaluate a winner. Based on 'opens', 'clicks', or 'manual'.

wait_units.title: Wait Time
wait_units.description: How unit of time for measuring the winner ('hours' or 'days'). This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

wait_time.title: Wait Time
wait_time.description: The amount of time to wait before picking a winner. This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

split_size.title: Split Size
split_size.description: The size of the split groups. Campaigns split based on 'schedule' are forced to have a 50/50 split. Valid split integers are between 1-50.

from_name_a.title: From Name Group A
from_name_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group A.

from_name_b.title: From Name Group B
from_name_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group B.

reply_email_a.title: Reply Email Group A
reply_email_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group A.

reply_email_b.title: Reply Email Group B
reply_email_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group B.

subject_a.title: Subject Line Group A
subject_a.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group A.

subject_b.title: Subject Line Group B
subject_b.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group B.

send_time_a.title: Send Time Group A
send_time_a.description: The send time for Group A.

send_time_b.title: Send Time Group B
send_time_b.description: The send time for Group B.

send_time_winner.title: Send Time Winner
send_time_winner.description: The send time for the winning version.

social_card.title: Campaign Social Card
social_card.description: The preview for the campaign, rendered by social networks like Facebook and Twitter. [Learn more](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-customize-social-cards/).

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: The url for the header image for the card.

description.title: Campaign Description
description.description: A short summary of the campaign to display.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the card. Typically the subject line of the campaign.

report_summary.title: Campaign Report Summary
report_summary.description: For sent campaigns, a summary of opens and clicks.

opens.title: Automation Opens
opens.description: The total number of opens for a campaign.

open_rate.title: Open Rate
open_rate.description: The number of unique opens divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

clicks.title: Total Clicks
clicks.description: The total number of clicks for an campaign.

click_rate.title: Click Rate
click_rate.description: The number of unique clicks divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

total_orders.title: Total Orders
total_orders.description: The total orders for a campaign.

total_spent.title: Total Spent
total_spent.description: The total spent for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals with no deductions.

total_revenue.title: Total Revenue
total_revenue.description: The total revenue for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals minus shipping and tax totals.

delivery_status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
delivery_status.description: Updates on campaigns in the process of sending.

enabled.title: Delivery Status Enabled
enabled.description: Whether Campaign Delivery Status is enabled for this account and campaign.

can_cancel.title: Campaign Cancelable
can_cancel.description: Whether a campaign send can be canceled.

status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
status.description: The current state of a campaign delivery.

emails_sent.title: Emails Sent
emails_sent.description: The total number of emails confirmed sent for this campaign so far.

emails_canceled.title: Emails Canceled
emails_canceled.description: The total number of emails canceled for this campaign.

address1.title: Address
address1.description: The street address for the list contact.

address2.title: Address
address2.description: The street address for the list contact.

use_archive_bar.description: Whether campaigns for this list use the [Archive Bar](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-email-campaign-archives-and-pages/) in archives by default.

campaign_defaults.title: Campaign Defaults
campaign_defaults.description: [Default values for campaigns](https://mailchimp.com/help/edit-your-emails-subject-preview-text-from-name-or-from-email-address/) created for this list.

from_name.title: Sender's Name
from_name.description: The default from name for campaigns sent to this list.

from_email.title: Sender's Email Address
from_email.description: The default from email for campaigns sent to this list.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The default subject line for campaigns sent to this list.

language.title: Language
language.description: The default language for this lists's forms.

notify_on_subscribe.title: Notify on Subscribe
notify_on_subscribe.description: The email address to send [subscribe notifications](https://mailchimp.com/help/change-subscribe-and-unsubscribe-notifications/) to.

notify_on_unsubscribe.title: Notify on Unsubscribe
notify_on_unsubscribe.description: The email address to send [unsubscribe notifications](https://mailchimp.com/help/change-subscribe-and-unsubscribe-notifications/) to.

date_created.title: Creation Date
date_created.description: The date and time that this list was created in ISO 8601 format.

list_rating.title: List Rating
list_rating.description: An auto-generated activity score for the list (0-5).

email_type_option.title: Email Type Option
email_type_option.description: Whether the list supports [multiple formats for emails](https://mailchimp.com/help/change-audience-name-defaults/). When set to `true`, subscribers can choose whether they want to receive HTML or plain-text emails. When set to `false`, subscribers will receive HTML emails, with a plain-text alternative backup.

subscribe_url_short.title: Subscribe URL Short
subscribe_url_short.description: Our [url shortened](https://mailchimp.com/help/share-your-signup-form/) version of this list's subscribe form.

subscribe_url_long.title: Subscribe URL Long
subscribe_url_long.description: The full version of this list's subscribe form (host will vary).

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Legacy - visibility settings are no longer used

double_optin.title: Double Opt In
double_optin.description: Whether or not to require the subscriber to confirm subscription via email.

has_welcome.title: Has Welcome
has_welcome.description: Whether or not this list has a welcome automation connected. Welcome Automations: welcomeSeries, singleWelcome, emailFollowup.

marketing_permissions.title: Marketing Permissions
marketing_permissions.description: Whether or not the list has marketing permissions (eg. GDPR) enabled.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Any list-specific modules installed for this list.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Stats for the list. Many of these are cached for at least five minutes.

member_count.title: Member Count
member_count.description: The number of active members in the list.

total_contacts.title: Total Contacts
total_contacts.description: The number of contacts in the list, including subscribed, unsubscribed, pending, cleaned, deleted, transactional, and those that need to be reconfirmed. Requires include_total_contacts query parameter to be included.

unsubscribe_count.title: Unsubscribe Count
unsubscribe_count.description: The number of members who have unsubscribed from the list.

cleaned_count.title: Cleaned Count
cleaned_count.description: The number of members cleaned from the list.

member_count_since_send.title: Member Count Since Send
member_count_since_send.description: The number of active members in the list since the last campaign was sent.

unsubscribe_count_since_send.title: Unsubscribe Count Since Send
unsubscribe_count_since_send.description: The number of members who have unsubscribed since the last campaign was sent.

cleaned_count_since_send.title: Cleaned Count Since Send
cleaned_count_since_send.description: The number of members cleaned from the list since the last campaign was sent.

campaign_count.title: Campaign Count
campaign_count.description: The number of campaigns in any status that use this list.

campaign_last_sent.title: Campaign Last Sent
campaign_last_sent.description: The date and time the last campaign was sent to this list in ISO 8601 format. This is updated when a campaign is sent to 10 or more recipients.

merge_field_count.title: Merge Field Count
merge_field_count.description: The number of merge fields ([audience field](https://mailchimp.com/help/getting-started-with-merge-tags/)) for this list (doesn't include EMAIL).

avg_sub_rate.title: Average Subscription Rate
avg_sub_rate.description: The average number of subscriptions per month for the list (not returned if we haven't calculated it yet).

avg_unsub_rate.title: Average Unsubscription Rate
avg_unsub_rate.description: The average number of unsubscriptions per month for the list (not returned if we haven't calculated it yet).

target_sub_rate.title: Average Subscription Rate
target_sub_rate.description: The target number of subscriptions per month for the list to keep it growing (not returned if we haven't calculated it yet).

open_rate.title: Open Rate
open_rate.description: The average open rate (a percentage represented as a number between 0 and 100) per campaign for the list (not returned if we haven't calculated it yet).

click_rate.title: Click Rate
click_rate.description: The average click rate (a percentage represented as a number between 0 and 100) per campaign for the list (not returned if we haven't calculated it yet).

last_sub_date.title: Date of Last List Subscribe
last_sub_date.description: The date and time of the last time someone subscribed to this list in ISO 8601 format.

last_unsub_date.title: Date of Last List Unsubscribe
last_unsub_date.description: The date and time of the last time someone unsubscribed from this list in ISO 8601 format.

get.description: Get information about all available segments for a specific list.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: exclude_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

parameters.name: list_id
parameters.description: The unique ID for the list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit results based on segment type.

parameters.name: since_created_at
parameters.description: Restrict results to segments created after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_created_at
parameters.description: Restrict results to segments created before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: include_cleaned
parameters.description: Include cleaned members in response

parameters.name: include_transactional
parameters.description: Include transactional members in response

parameters.name: include_unsubscribed
parameters.description: Include unsubscribed members in response

parameters.name: since_updated_at
parameters.description: Restrict results to segments update after the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_updated_at
parameters.description: Restrict results to segments update before the set time. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: exclude_type
parameters.description: Exclude results based on segment type. For example, use `exclude_type=static` to exclude tags from the response.

parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

parameters.description: The unique ID for the list.

parameters.name: email_type
parameters.description: The email type.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The subscriber's status.

parameters.name: since_timestamp_opt
parameters.description: Restrict results to subscribers who opted-in after the set timeframe. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_timestamp_opt
parameters.description: Restrict results to subscribers who opted-in before the set timeframe. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: since_last_changed
parameters.description: Restrict results to subscribers whose information changed after the set timeframe. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: before_last_changed
parameters.description: Restrict results to subscribers whose information changed before the set timeframe. Uses ISO 8601 time format: 2015-10-21T15:41:36+00:00.

parameters.name: unique_email_id
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the email address across all Mailchimp lists.

parameters.name: vip_only
parameters.description: A filter to return only the list's VIP members. Passing `true` will restrict results to VIP list members, passing `false` will return all list members.

parameters.name: interest_category_id
parameters.description: The unique id for the interest category.

parameters.name: interest_ids
parameters.description: Used to filter list members by interests. Must be accompanied by interest_category_id and interest_match. The value must be a comma separated list of interest ids present for any supplied interest categories.

parameters.name: interest_match
parameters.description: Used to filter list members by interests. Must be accompanied by interest_category_id and interest_ids. "any" will match a member with any of the interest supplied, "all" will only match members with every interest supplied, and "none" will match members without any of the interest supplied.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: Returns files sorted by the specified field.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: Determines the order direction for sorted results.

parameters.name: since_last_campaign
parameters.description: Filter subscribers by those subscribed/unsubscribed/pending/cleaned since last email campaign send. Member status is required to use this filter.

parameters.name: unsubscribed_since
parameters.description: Filter subscribers by those unsubscribed since a specific date. Using any status other than unsubscribed with this filter will result in an error.

This may be determined automatically by click rate, open rate, or total revenue -- or you may choose manually based on the reporting data you find the most valuable. For Multivariate Campaigns testing send_time, winner_criteria is ignored. For Multivariate Campaigns with 'manual' as the winner_criteria, the winner must be chosen in the Mailchimp web application.

from_names.description: The possible from names. The number of from_names provided must match the number of reply_to_addresses. If no from_names are provided, settings.from_name will be used.

reply_to_addresses.title: Reply To Addresses
reply_to_addresses.description: The possible reply-to addresses. The number of reply_to_addresses provided must match the number of from_names. If no reply_to_addresses are provided, settings.reply_to will be used.

contents.title: Content Descriptions
contents.description: Descriptions of possible email contents. To set campaign contents, make a PUT request to /campaigns/{campaign_id}/content with the field 'variate_contents'.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.description: Combinations of possible variables used to build emails.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique ID for the combination.

subject_line.title: Subject Line
subject_line.description: The index of `variate_settings.subject_lines` used.

send_time.title: Send Time
send_time.description: The index of `variate_settings.send_times` used.

from_name.title: From Name
from_name.description: The index of `variate_settings.from_names` used.

reply_to.title: Reply To
reply_to.description: The index of `variate_settings.reply_to_addresses` used.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: The number of recipients for this combination.

tracking.title: Campaign Tracking Options
tracking.description: The tracking options for a campaign.

opens.title: Opens
opens.description: Whether to [track opens](https://mailchimp.com/help/about-open-tracking/). Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

html_clicks.title: HTML Click Tracking
html_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the HTML version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

text_clicks.title: Plain-Text Click Tracking
text_clicks.description: Whether to [track clicks](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-view-click-tracking/) in the plain-text version of the campaign. Defaults to `true`. Cannot be set to false for variate campaigns.

google_analytics.title: Google Analytics Tracking
google_analytics.description: The custom slug for [Google Analytics](https://mailchimp.com/help/integrate-google-analytics-with-mailchimp/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

clicktale.title: ClickTale Analytics Tracking
clicktale.description: The custom slug for [ClickTale](https://mailchimp.com/help/additional-tracking-options-for-campaigns/) tracking (max of 50 bytes).

campaign.title: Salesforce Campaign
campaign.description: Create a campaign in a connected Salesforce account.

notes.title: Salesforce Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

notes.title: Capsule Note
notes.description: Update contact notes for a campaign based on subscriber email addresses.

feed_url.title: Feed URL
feed_url.description: The URL for the RSS feed.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: The frequency of the RSS Campaign.

schedule.title: Sending Schedule
schedule.description: The schedule for sending the RSS Campaign.

hour.title: Sending Hour
hour.description: The hour to send the campaign in local time. Acceptable hours are 0-23. For example, '4' would be 4am in [your account's default time zone](https://mailchimp.com/help/set-account-details/).

daily_send.title: Daily Sending Days
daily_send.description: The days of the week to send a daily RSS Campaign.

sunday.title: Sunday
sunday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Sundays.

monday.title: Monday
monday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Mondays.

tuesday.title: tuesday
tuesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Tuesdays.

wednesday.title: Monday
wednesday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Wednesdays.

thursday.title: Thursday
thursday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Thursdays.

friday.title: Friday
friday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Fridays.

saturday.title: Saturday
saturday.description: Sends the daily RSS Campaign on Saturdays.

weekly_send_day.title: Weekly Sending Day
weekly_send_day.description: The day of the week to send a weekly RSS Campaign.

monthly_send_date.title: Monthly Sending Day
monthly_send_date.description: The day of the month to send a monthly RSS Campaign. Acceptable days are 0-31, where '0' is always the last day of a month. Months with fewer than the selected number of days will not have an RSS campaign sent out that day. For example, RSS Campaigns set to send on the 30th will not go out in February.

last_sent.title: Last Sent
last_sent.description: The date the campaign was last sent.

constrain_rss_img.title: Constrain RSS Images
constrain_rss_img.description: Whether to add CSS to images in the RSS feed to constrain their width in campaigns.

split_test.title: Split Test
split_test.description: The type of AB split to run.

pick_winner.title: Pick Winner
pick_winner.description: How we should evaluate a winner. Based on 'opens', 'clicks', or 'manual'.

wait_units.title: Wait Time
wait_units.description: How unit of time for measuring the winner ('hours' or 'days'). This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

wait_time.title: Wait Time
wait_time.description: The amount of time to wait before picking a winner. This cannot be changed after a campaign is sent.

split_size.title: Split Size
split_size.description: The size of the split groups. Campaigns split based on 'schedule' are forced to have a 50/50 split. Valid split integers are between 1-50.

from_name_a.title: From Name Group A
from_name_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group A.

from_name_b.title: From Name Group B
from_name_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the name for Group B.

reply_email_a.title: Reply Email Group A
reply_email_a.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group A.

reply_email_b.title: Reply Email Group B
reply_email_b.description: For campaigns split on 'From Name', the reply-to address for Group B.

subject_a.title: Subject Line Group A
subject_a.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group A.

subject_b.title: Subject Line Group B
subject_b.description: For campaigns split on 'Subject Line', the subject line for Group B.

send_time_a.title: Send Time Group A
send_time_a.description: The send time for Group A.

send_time_b.title: Send Time Group B
send_time_b.description: The send time for Group B.

send_time_winner.title: Send Time Winner
send_time_winner.description: The send time for the winning version.

social_card.title: Campaign Social Card
social_card.description: The preview for the campaign, rendered by social networks like Facebook and Twitter. [Learn more](https://mailchimp.com/help/enable-and-customize-social-cards/).

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: The url for the header image for the card.

description.title: Campaign Description
description.description: A short summary of the campaign to display.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title for the card. Typically the subject line of the campaign.

report_summary.title: Campaign Report Summary
report_summary.description: For sent campaigns, a summary of opens and clicks.

opens.title: Automation Opens
opens.description: The total number of opens for a campaign.

open_rate.title: Open Rate
open_rate.description: The number of unique opens divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

clicks.title: Total Clicks
clicks.description: The total number of clicks for an campaign.

click_rate.title: Click Rate
click_rate.description: The number of unique clicks divided by the total number of successful deliveries.

total_orders.title: Total Orders
total_orders.description: The total orders for a campaign.

total_spent.title: Total Spent
total_spent.description: The total spent for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals with no deductions.

total_revenue.title: Total Revenue
total_revenue.description: The total revenue for a campaign. Calculated as the sum of all order totals minus shipping and tax totals.

delivery_status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
delivery_status.description: Updates on campaigns in the process of sending.

enabled.title: Delivery Status Enabled
enabled.description: Whether Campaign Delivery Status is enabled for this account and campaign.

can_cancel.title: Campaign Cancelable
can_cancel.description: Whether a campaign send can be canceled.

status.title: Campaign Delivery Status
status.description: The current state of a campaign delivery.

emails_sent.title: Emails Sent
emails_sent.description: The total number of emails confirmed sent for this campaign so far.

emails_canceled.title: Emails Canceled
emails_canceled.description: The total number of emails canceled for this campaign.

parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: exclude_fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to exclude. Reference parameters of sub-objects with dot notation.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of records to return. Default value is 10. Maximum value is 1000

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Used for [pagination](https://mailchimp.com/developer/marketing/docs/methods-parameters/#pagination), this is the number of records from a collection to skip. Default value is 0.

parameters.name: store_id
parameters.description: The store id.

schema.description: An error generated by the Mailchimp API. Conforms to IETF draft 'draft-nottingham-http-problem-06'.

type.title: Problem Type
type.description: An absolute URI that identifies the problem type. When dereferenced, it should provide human-readable documentation for the problem type.

title.title: Error Title
title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. It shouldn't change based on the occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

status.title: HTTP Status Code
status.description: The HTTP status code (RFC2616, Section 6) generated by the origin server for this occurrence of the problem.

detail.title: Error Message
detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. [Learn more about errors](/developer/guides/get-started-with-mailchimp-api-3/#Errors).
detail.example: The requested resource could not be found.

instance.title: Instance ID
instance.description: A string that identifies this specific occurrence of the problem. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

id.description: A unique identifier for the promo rule. If Ecommerce platform does not support promo rule, use promo code id as promo rule id. Restricted to UTF-8 characters with max length 50.

title.title: Title
title.description: The title that will show up in promotion campaign. Restricted to UTF-8 characters with max length of 100 bytes.

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of a promotion restricted to UTF-8 characters with max length 255.
description.example: Save BIG during our summer sale!

starts_at.title: Promo Start Time
starts_at.description: The date and time when the promotion is in effect in ISO 8601 format.

ends_at.title: End Time
ends_at.description: The date and time when the promotion ends. Must be after starts_at and in ISO 8601 format.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: The amount of the promo code discount. If 'type' is 'fixed', the amount is treated as a monetary value. If 'type' is 'percentage', amount must be a decimal value between 0.0 and 1.0, inclusive.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of discount. For free shipping set type to fixed.

target.title: Target
target.description: The target that the discount applies to.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the promo rule is currently enabled.

created_at_foreign.title: Foreign Create Time
created_at_foreign.description: The date and time the promotion was created in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at_foreign.title: Foreign Update Time
updated_at_foreign.description: The date and time the promotion was updated in ISO 8601 format.
